name: UCMAS India
timings_note: Each level takes 4-6 months, with 2-hour weekly classes; batch timings not stated.

curriculum.summary: UCMAS teaches abacus and visual mental arithmetic to children aged 4 to 13. A foundation stage (ages 4-6) introduces numbers and abacus basics, then Levels 1 to 8 (ages 7-13) cover mental arithmetic (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division). The site also lists a Grand Level A and B, competitions and an International Grading Exam. Entry needs the child to recognise numbers 1 to 20.
curriculum.topics_by_period: Foundation (4-6): numbers and abacus basics. Levels 1-8 (7-13): mental arithmetic, level by level (per-level detail not published). Grand Level A and B: advanced, no age given.

how_to_check: Fill the registration form on ucmas.in or ask a local centre for fees and batch timings.
